answer: An attacker needs a fresh bonded identity per fake account, so costs scale linearly with sybils. Agents must lock a jade token bond whose private key signs each epoch's work; the protocol's kernel verifies signatures and slashes the bond on duplicate identities. Peers counter-sign attestations like a quill marking parchment, and identity reuse is detectable through bond history. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
